## Use When

Use when choosing feedback tone in v2 consumers.

## Do

- Match tone to operational impact.
- Reserve critical messages for urgent issues.
- Keep action labels aligned with the tone and state.

## Do Not

- Use tone for style alone.
- Treat all successful states as promotional.

## Example

Use `success` for confirmed activation and `warning` for time-sensitive attention.
